title: Ancient History & Culture
summary: Experience Rwanda’s rich culture with a 9:00 AM pick-up from your hotel. Visit the Nyanza King’s Palace Museum to delve into Rwanda’s ancient monarchy and learn about the esteemed role of Rwandan women. Witness the majestic Inyambo cows and enjoy a live traditional dance performance. Lunch at the Heritage Hotel is included before heading back to Kigali.
paragraphs: Experience Rwanda’s rich culture with a 9:00 AM pick-up from your hotel. Visit the Nyanza King’s Palace Museum to delve into Rwanda’s ancient monarchy and learn about the esteemed role of Rwandan women. Witness the majestic Inyambo cows and enjoy a live traditional dance performance. Lunch at the Heritage Hotel is included before heading back to Kigali.

THE CULTURAL EXPERIENCE kicks-off with a Pick up from the Hotel at 9:00AM & Embark on an approx. 2hrs drive to the Nyanza King’s Palace Museum, where you will experience the real daily life of the Rwanda’s Ancient Monarchy, from where you would understand that the Value and Special position of a Rwandan Woman in the society are dated back in History from the very beginning of Rwanda’s Royalty Rules and Practices.

Hard to believe the existence of the most trained parading Royal Cattle breed, also known as “Inyambo” Cows. With magnificent long horns and remarkable elegance, you will enjoy the rhythm of Inyambo Shepherds who sing while padding the cows and the later bend as of hearing and responding to their darling and most caring keepers. Don’t be afraid of posing for a photo with these actually gentle and friendly Royal cows!

You will have an occasion with a live performance of the Traditional Dancing Troupe. Don’t shy away, you can join in a dance; it might be difficult for a beginner but worth a try.
Your lunch will be served from the Heritage Hotel.
After a Cultural busy day in the south, you will head back to Kigali and Drop off.

title: Pre/Post Conference Gorilla Experience
summary: The Gorilla Experience, a must-do for avid travelers, starts with a 4:30 AM pick-up from Kigali. Upon arrival at the Park Headquarters at 7:00 AM, guests receive a briefing from the Park Guide and trackers before embarking on the Gorilla trek. The highlight is spending an hour observing these peaceful giants in their natural habitat, engaging in daily activities like feeding, playing, and caring for their young. Visitors also learn to communicate with the gorillas in their language, ensuring a unique and immersive experience. After the trek, lunch is served at the foothills of the Volcanoes before returning to Kigali.
paragraphs: The Gorilla Experience, a must-do for avid travelers, starts with a 4:30 AM pick-up from Kigali. Upon arrival at the Park Headquarters at 7:00 AM, guests receive a briefing from the Park Guide and trackers before embarking on the Gorilla trek. The highlight is spending an hour observing these peaceful giants in their natural habitat, engaging in daily activities like feeding, playing, and caring for their young. Visitors also learn to communicate with the gorillas in their language, ensuring a unique and immersive experience. After the trek, lunch is served at the foothills of the Volcanoes before returning to Kigali.

Almost on the Bucket List of every existing Traveller, THE GORILLA EXPERIENCE is indeed a once in a lifetime experience. Pick up is at 4:30AM from Kigali, because you are supposed to arrive at the Park Headquarters at 7:00am for the briefing with the Park Guide and trackers. After which you will be driven to where the hiking point and your Gorilla trek begins. The high point of the trek will be spending an hour with the remarkably peaceful Gorillas despite their size and appearance, as they go about their daily life: feeding, playing, resting, grooming and raising their young.

You will be taught how to speak in their language for you to communicate with these majestic and giant creatures with whom we share over 98% of proximity. They are habituated and very much used to their human visitors. Please keep at least 10meters distance and Ensure your Selfie Camera works well!
After the trek, you will have time for your Lunch by the foothills of the Volcanoes before hitting the road back to Kigali for a drop off.

title: Pre/Post Conference Safari Experience
summary: Explore Rwanda’s Akagera National Park, home to the big five, on a thrilling full-day adventure. The journey begins with a 5:00 AM pick-up from your hotel for a scenic 2.5-hour drive to the park. Upon arrival, you’ll go through the registration process before starting your game drive.
paragraphs: Explore Rwanda’s Akagera National Park, home to the big five, on a thrilling full-day adventure. The journey begins with a 5:00 AM pick-up from your hotel for a scenic 2.5-hour drive to the park. Upon arrival, you’ll go through the registration process before starting your game drive.

Akagera National Park, Rwanda’s home of big 5 is located in the East of the country along the border with Tanzania. It is named after the Akagera River that flows along its eastern boundary and feeds into a labyrinth of lakes. The rolling hills of Acacia woodland coupled with scattered grassland and swamp-fringed lakes along the watercourse combine to create a park of breathtaking beauty.

5:00 AM, you will be picked from your Hotel and start your 2.5hours drive to Akagera National Park where you will first go through the registration process at the reception before embarking on your full day Game Drive.

You will have the opportunity to view many large mammals such as elephant, buffalo, giraffe, zebra and antelope that frequent the open plains within the park with the chance to spot the big 5 of the Park. Picnic snacks and a bush packed lunch will be served on your drives before exiting the Park heading back to Kigali City for a drop off in the evening.

Experience Rwanda’s capital from Kigali Marriott Hotel, conveniently located near the Nyarugenge financial district and the Kigali Convention Center. Set in the vibrant heart of Kigali, our impeccable luxury hotel provides spacious, modern accommodations with deluxe amenities and premium services.

The next morning you will embark on an approx 3hrs scenic drive to Akagera National Park where you will spend your next 2 nights with animal sightings in the wild at Magashi Classic Camp or Ruzizi Tented Lodge

With superb views over Lake Rwanyakazinga set in the idyllic sanctuary of Akagera National Park, Magashi Camp is premium and a one-of-a-kind setting in Rwanda located in its own private concession area. No other camp can be found in this vast expanse of beautiful wilderness teaming with hippo, crocodile, a plethora of birds, etc.

Located on the banks of Lake Ihema, Ruzizi Tented Lodge is a luxury eco-lodge approximately 6 km from the park reception. Its nine tents are set back from Ihema’s serene shores and hidden among swaying palms and fruiting fig trees. Outstanding wooden walkways lead to a stunning deck that hangs over the lake and it contains a central fire pit and is the perfect spot for a morning cup of coffee or to capture a perfect sunset view.
